label: Fused prefill attention
mechanism: prefill attention runs as one flash-style Triton kernel with the rel-bias gathered in-kernel by distance, so no [B,heads,T,T] score, bias or mask tensor is ever materialized and the out-of-window tiles are never visited
hypothesis: attn_prefill #3-#8 is the last bring-up-era eager chain in the engine and it runs entirely through a materialized [B,heads,T,T] bf16 score tensor. At a canonical 6-row cohort padded to T=1536 that tensor is 1.81 GB and the chain touches score-shaped memory about a dozen times per layer: rel_bias builds the [B,H,T,E] mix, gathers it into a [B,H,T,T] bias and masked_fills that; the QK matmul writes scores; `* scale`, `+ bias` and `+ mask` each read and write them; softmax(dtype=fp32) writes a 3.62 GB fp32 copy that `.to(bf16)` reads back; the PV matmul reads the result; and repeat_kv materializes K and V at 64 heads first. ~26 GB of HBM traffic per layer to produce a 19 MB output, ~1.7 TB per traversal. Two things make that the right target NOW. (1) THE PREFILL DEVICES ARE SATURATED, which was the open question exp-0021's post-mortem left ('per-device GPU-BUSY time ... has still not been run'): it did not need a new run, because exp-0018's own /workspace/logs/t_pipeline_bubble_exp0018_util.log sampled utilization every 0.4 s DURING the worker's canonical bench and every prefill-phase sample reads 92-100% on exactly one device and 0% on the other three. utilization.gpu is a kernel-resident fraction, so a dispatch-starved device cannot read 99%; arm b's '696 ms host / 0.1 ms device tail' was the host blocking inside the launch path of a busy device. Deleting DEVICE work from prefill therefore pays at face value, and 'delete Python from prefill' is not the lever exp-0021 thought it was. (2) exp-0022 (accepted, 353.6 tok/s) cut the decode step to a measured 0.072 s, so prefill is now ~57% of the box. ONE VARIABLE: kernels/attn_prefill.py (new) plus the fused branch in model.attn_prefill behind PYENGINE_FUSED_PREFILL_ATTN=0, which reads the module global at call time; the eager chain is retained verbatim behind it, and layer_prefill gains one kwarg (window=mc.window) so the kernel's band is the config's, not an inference from the rel extent. The kernel is exp-0013's design applied to the other phase: one @triton.jit body for both layer shapes, GQA internal (repeat_kv's copies disappear), K/V read in place from whatever strides they arrive with (the CPU pre-gate found post-sconv K/V are CHANNEL-MAJOR - sconv_prefill's own-input residual keeps conv.transpose(1,2)'s layout - which also means the eager matmul was paying a contiguity copy the fused path deletes), rel bias gathered by clamp(dist,0,E-1) and zeroed out of band exactly as rel_bias #3/#4, the causal/window predicate applied as selection to -1e38 exactly as additive_causal_mask's, fp32 online softmax, probs downcast to bf16 for the PV dot as #7 does, output written straight into [B,T,H,D] so #8's transpose+contiguous disappears. tau rides on the [B,H,T,E] mix instead of the gathered bias - the gather is a pure copy, so it is the same per-element fp32 multiply and bf16 round on every live pair and 0 stays 0 on the dead ones. EVIDENCE, isolated (engine/pyengine/tests/t_fused_prefill_attn.py --gpu, log /workspace/logs/t_fused_prefill_attn_exp0023_gpu.log, CUDA-event timed ON THE LAYER'S DEVICE - timing on the default device's stream measures an idle stream, which is how the first draft of this arm read 0.5 ms for a 1.81 GB chain): SWA 15.747 -> 1.310 ms/layer (12.0x), global 21.481 -> 6.156 ms/layer (3.5x), tiles swept 64x64 / 64x32 / 128x64 / 32x64 with 64x64 winning both and pinned at the call site; peak memory 11.913 -> 2.205 GiB (SWA) and 12.721 -> 7.936 GiB (global); rel_mean 3.824e-03, cos 0.999991, finite; two runs bitwise equal. EVIDENCE, IN SITU on the real resident model, which is what exp-0011's rejection and exp-0018's null say must decide it (engine/pyengine/tests/t_prefill_attn_insitu.py, one resident load, arms INTERLEAVED off/on/off/on after a discarded warm-up, canonical 6-row cohort at ISL 690-800 landing on 8 residents; log /workspace/logs/t_prefill_attn_insitu_exp0023_out.log): the MIXED step goes 1.053 -> 0.796 s = 1.323x (-257 ms) with repeats agreeing to 2 ms (1.056/1.049 eager, 0.797/0.795 fused), and the 8-row prefill step 1.335 -> 0.999 s (its first fused run reads 2.232 s because a T=800 traversal recompiles the kernel's divisibility specialization after a T=745 warm-up - JIT, not the mechanism, and it is why the arms are interleaved and repeated). DETERMINISM: fused run1 == run2 bitwise on the whole 14-sequence token stream (the t_b3-adapted arm); the kernel is fixed-grid, fixed-tile, atomics-free, no autotune. Eager and fused token streams DIFFER on 7 of 14 sequences - expected and not hidden: the numerics move by reduction order (fp32 flash accumulation vs a bf16-rounded score tensor, the B3.1/B3.3 class), the prompts here are random ids so the argmax sits on a flat distribution, and the binding check is the D13 gate below, not stream equality.
predicted_delta: +8 to +14% timeboxed decode_heavy tok/s: 382-403 vs the accepted exp-0022 row 353.6 (merge bar 354.7). Cycle model, from exp-0022's own ledger block (613 s, 1694 requests, 216832 tokens) and the in-situ step walls: 216832/64 = 3388 graphed decode steps, ~1694/6 = 282 cohort prefill traversals, so ~282 mixed steps at 1.053 s = 297 s + ~3106 pure decode steps at 0.072 s = 224 s = 521 s of the 613 s box (the remaining ~90 s is cohort formation, HTTP and drain). The mechanism removes 0.257 s from each mixed step: 282 x 0.257 = 72 s, 613 -> 541 s, 353.6 x 613/541 = 401 tok/s. I discount to 382-403 because cohorts are not always full 6 and the saving scales with the cohort's padded Tmax. FLOOR CASE: the saving is a fixed number of GPU-milliseconds on a traversal whose devices are measured saturated, and it was measured through the real Scheduler rather than extrapolated from a kernel bench, so a result near 354 would mean the canonical box has far fewer full-cohort prefills than exp-0017's admission logic implies - which would itself be worth knowing. prefill_heavy rides the same seam much harder (ISL 8192: the eager path's score tensor is 8.6 GB for a SINGLE sequence, which is why the padded-scores budget sends those prompts down the per-seq path at all) and should be remeasured as a point row later.

local_pregate.tf_gate: GREEN on this exact tree (GPUs 4-7, one resident load, --tf-positions 8 matching the envelope's k_per_prompt; log /workspace/logs/tf_gate_exp0023.log): parity_pass true, agree 382/400 = 0.955, delta_mean 0.052153 vs bar 0.054281, delta_max 0.592755. The accepted lineage reads delta_mean 0.056637 / delta_max 1.336095, so this patch moved BOTH toward the goldens while dropping one token of agreement (383 -> 382). That direction is what fp32 flash accumulation should do against goldens produced by a flash-attention implementation, and it is the same signature exp-0016's W4A4 prefill showed.
local_pregate.determinism: t_prefill_attn_insitu arm c (two identical fused schedules, bitwise-equal token streams for 14 sequences) and t_fused_prefill_attn arm g (two identical kernel launches, bitwise-equal tensors). Fixed grid, fixed tiles, no atomics, no autotune, one JIT specialization per (shape class, divisibility) - so the kernel sequence is a pure function of the schedule.
local_pregate.algebra: CPU arms with no CUDA context (t_fused_prefill_attn --sim, log /workspace/logs/t_fused_prefill_attn_exp0023_sim.log): a literal torch transcription of the kernel matches the engine's OWN eager chain in fp32 to 4.8e-07 on both layer shapes, right-padded rows are bit-exact against the same rows run alone with garbage left in the pads, tau-on-the-mix equals tau-on-the-gathered-bias with the floor lowered so tau actually varies, and the kernel's mask predicate is bitwise additive_causal_mask's for both window forms. This pre-gate ran BEFORE any GPU was free and caught the channel-major K/V layout bug.
